What's in the box

Six things you can have running in an afternoon

Build a voice agent or plug speech into your existing stack, with APIs for the conversation, call controls, and what happens afterward.

Explore the APIs
Telephony · AMD

Your agent gets a phone number

Connect a managed number or your own carrier, with transfers, hold, and keypad input built in. On outbound calls, AMD tells you who picked up: a person, a voicemail, or a screening assistant.

Build an inbound support line, a callback flow, or routing based on who answers.

Telephony docs
Hear

You see the words as they're spoken

Hear gives your app a live view of the call, updating the transcript as the caller speaks and marking each utterance final. About 200 ms to the first partial, measured in-region.

Build live captions, or index recorded calls for search.

Hear docs
Omni · Agents

Build the agent around your own functions

Connect your instructions, knowledge, and application tools, so the agent can check an order, find an appointment, and respond with the result during the call.

Configure and test it in Agents, or build directly with the Omni SDK.

Omni docs
Speak

Your text becomes the voice they hear

Choose a stock, cloned, or designed voice, then stream spoken responses in the audio format your app needs. Speech starts within about 53 ms, measured in-region.

Add spoken replies to your app, generate phone prompts, or feed your existing pipeline.

Speak docs
Recap

The call ends with data your app can use

Receive a summary, a disposition, the next step, and structured fields you define. Deliver the result through a webhook or a supported integration when the call ends.

Capture booking details, create a CRM note, or pass a summary into your workflow.

Recap docs
Trace · Beta

Review each finding alongside its rule

Submit calls against your rule packs and retrieve scorecards with cited findings, redactions, and a tamper-evident audit hash. Works on calls from any stack.

Build a review queue, flag specific findings, or bring evaluations into your dashboard.

Trace docs

Working with longer recordings? Generate directed narration with Cast, or translate and dub existing recordings into supported languages with Dub. Open starter examples →

Our point of view

Three lessons from a billion calls

01Hear

Phone audio needs its own training data

Accents, noise, and compression come with the call. Hear is tuned for 8 kHz narrowband audio, so it transcribes what your phone line delivers.

4.76% word error rateon phone audio with accents
02Omni

Turn-taking has to be built into the model

Hearing, thinking, and speaking operate as a single model, so it stops when the caller does and replies at a human pace.

About 390 msfrom the caller stopping to the reply starting
03Telephony · Omni · Recap

One system has to run the whole call

The line, the conversation, and the notes run together, so there is one place to debug and one bill to read.

One accountone key, one bill

Drag from a studio microphone to a phone line. The band above 3.4 kHz disappears. Hear was trained on what's left.

Applications

Build on the API

Get a free key
AI Services

Build it with us

When the workflow needs more than an API, our engineers scope and ship it with you on the same layer.

AI Services

Keep your stack.
Nothing you run today has to go

  • On the OpenAI SDK? Change the base URL and the key. Speech and transcription work the same.
  • On Twilio, Plivo, or your own carrier? Keep it. Or take a managed number in the US or India.
  • On LiveKit or Pipecat? PyAI drops in as the voice, and your loop stays yours.
  • On HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zendesk? The call notes write into them.
# before
client = OpenAI()

# after
client = OpenAI(
  base_url="https://api.pyai.com/v1",
  api_key=os.environ["PYAI_API_KEY"])

# everything else stays
client.audio.speech.create(
  model="pyai-speak", voice="stock_ava_en_us",
  input="Hi, thanks for calling.")
// before
const client = new OpenAI();

// after
const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: "https://api.pyai.com/v1",
  apiKey: process.env.PYAI_API_KEY });

// everything else stays
await client.audio.speech.create({
  model: "pyai-speak", voice: "stock_ava_en_us",
  input: "Hi, thanks for calling." });
# same request shape as OpenAI's
curl https://api.pyai.com/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PYAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"pyai-speak",
       "voice":"stock_ava_en_us",
       "input":"Hi, thanks for calling."}' \
  -o speech.mp3
Security and compliance

For the people who have to sign it off

Trust & security

Your data stays on your servers

Your knowledge base never moves. PyAI reads what each answer needs, at the moment it needs it.

Keys never reach the browser

Each key is scoped to one project and lives on your server. Browsers get short-lived tokens.

Recording stays off until you turn it on

Recording is off by default. You set the consent line, retention period, and regional rules per call.

Every reviewed call keeps its evidence

Trace stores the rule, the finding, and a tamper-evident hash together, ready for an audit.

FAQs

Before you get a key

Anything else, write to us. A person reads it, usually the same day.

Is this AtomsAI or PyAI?

PyAI is the infrastructure layer of AtomsAI, with its own console, docs, and pricing. You build on the same layer our products do.

Do I need your products to use it?

No. Bring your own app, carrier, and CRM.

How fast is it on a real call?

About 390 ms from the caller finishing a sentence to hearing the reply, measured in-region. Not an SLA.

Does my OpenAI code work?

For speech and transcription, yes, after changing the base URL and the key. Real-time agents use PyAI's own connection, which the SDKs handle.

Which languages?

Twenty in all. Twelve have voice agents, nineteen have text-to-speech, eleven have speech-to-text.

Where do I start?

Get a free sandbox key, or tell us what you're building and we'll start there.

Start

Get a key,
or get in touch

A free key needs no card and no sales call. If the workflow needs more than an API, tell us, and we'll build it with you.

Get a free API key Talk to AtomsAI
